newsitem.title: USA: FirstMerit Q2 saw record returns on equity.
newsitem.headline: FirstMerit Q2 saw record returns on equity.

text.p: FirstMerit Corp said Wednesday its second quarter featured record returns on equity and assets at levels of 16.70 percent and 1.63 percent, respectively.
That compares to second quarter 1996 levels of 14.61 percent and 1.40 percent, respectively.
The company said higher fee income levels and reduced operating costs, combined with favorable interest rate margins, are the major factors contributing to its performance.
The company reported second quarter earnings per share of $0.67 versus $0.59 for the same period a year ago.
